title: CLEAN-40-LARGE: large vector output blocks and one wide coarse batch at2/5 depth

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N),the SINGLE CLEAN-40-LARGE algorithm of proof.md/qudit_decoder.md/robust_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Mainn>=2^48 uses exact m=ceil(n^(2/5)), tapered actual-width trees, bmax=floor(H/2)-1024u, per-block r=b+ceilLog(n^5), ONE explicit wide-top coarse batch, sequential signed odd/twoadic vectors and ONE global A=4Lblk fine-attempt cap. All source rejections, failed/missing/capped attempts, incorrect histories, bit operations, actual lookups, addresses, source/extraction, table/circuit generation, explicit finiteprecision Clifford+T synthesis, initialization,gates,measurements,resets and ALL acquired/discarded/padded1024-copy microbanks count. ALLFOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch,with separately proved finite exhaustive correctness and uniform absolute resource constants. F(n)=n^(3/5)+(1/2)n^(2/5)-n^(1/5) is the complete exact exponent. Resource envelopes usepositive n2 values atn1. Total charged work O(n^(14/5)2^F), exact index3/5.
